pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions within 15 minutes of a prior stop-out or during high-volatility liquidity sweeps.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 1.5 ATR breakout confirmation away from key liquidity nodes prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10.00 and let the remaining half run with a structural trailing stop to target +$25.00+.
